name: hypen-web
description: Hypen Web SDK Monorepo - Declarative UI with stateful modules

scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:web && bun run build:server && bun run build:web-engine
scripts.setup:wasm: echo 'WASM is now copied by server and web-engine build scripts'
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:web && bun run typecheck:server && bun run typecheck:web-engine && bun run typecheck:cf
scripts.playground: bun build playground/playground.ts --outdir playground --target browser && cp playground/hypen_engine_bg-*.wasm playground/hypen_engine_bg.wasm 2>/dev/null || true && bun --hot playground/server.ts
scripts.replayground: cd .. && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg/nodejs && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/browser && cd hypen-web && pkill -f 'playground/server.ts' || pkill -f 'bun.*playground' || lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true && cp ../pkg/browser/hypen_engine_bg.wasm playground/ && bun build playground/playground.ts --outdir playground --target browser && bun --hot playground/server.ts
scripts.publish:all: bun run build && bun run publish:core && bun run publish:web && bun run publish:server && bun run publish:web-engine

author: Hypen
